description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for byte arrays, BitArray, and related buffer types within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines codecs, copiers, and serializers for various byte and memory buffer types, including deep copy implementations and reference handling.

classes.name: BitArrayCodec
classes.description: Serializer for BitArray objects, handling reading and writing of BitArray data with support for reference tracking.

classes.name: BitArrayCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for BitArray objects, creating deep copies and supporting shallow copying.

classes.name: ByteArrayCodec
classes.description: Serializer for byte[] arrays, handling reading and writing with reference support.

classes.name: ByteArrayCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for byte[] arrays, creating deep copies.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryOfByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, handling reading and writing with reference support.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryOfByteCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, creating copies from memory segments.

classes.name: ArraySegmentOfByteCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for ArraySegment<byte>, creating copies of the segment.

classes.name: MemoryOfByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for Memory<byte>, handling reading and writing with reference support.

classes.name: MemoryOfByteCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for Memory<byte>, creating copies from memory segments.

classes.name: PooledBufferCodec
classes.description: Serializer for PooledBuffer instances, handling serialization and deserialization of buffer segments.

classes.name: PooledBufferCopier
classes.description: Shallow copier for PooledBuffer, assuming immutability.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a byte array or memory segment from the serialization stream, handling reference tracking and wire type validation.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a byte array or memory segment to the serialization stream, with support for reference tracking and expected type handling.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input buffer or memory segment, utilizing the copy context.
